pages.text: Each specialized fishing rod has a built-in $(l)Passive Ability$() (Biome Affinity).$(br)$(br)Passive effects increase your chance to catch unique and legendary fish belonging to that specific biome!

Passive Overview:$(br)$(br)• $(l)Ice / Sand Rod$(): Standard stats without biome affinity.$(br)• $(l)Jungle Rod$(): Higher luck.$(br)• $(l)Swamp Rod$(): Swamp biome catch bonus.$(br)• $(l)Mushroom Rod$(): Maximum catch rate for fungal species.
